overview:
Stax is a strategy consulting firm serving private equity firms and corporate clients. Founded in 1994 by Rafi Musher, the firm specializes in commercial due diligence, value creation, and exit planning. Its published case studies describe expert interviews and web surveys as inputs to consulting engagements.

Grant Thornton Advisors completed its acquisition of Stax on September 22, 2025. The closing announcement reported approximately 300 Stax team members and said the combined firms served almost 70% of the U.S.-based Private Equity International 300 at that time. Stax is now a wholly-owned subsidiary of Grant Thornton Advisors LLC.

Stax describes analytics services covering location analysis, customer behavior, and market forecasting. In a case study published in September 2019, it reported more than 1,200 interviews across 11 countries, using in-person interviews, telephone interviews, and a web survey for a dental implants manufacturer.

history.narrative:
Rafi Musher founded Stax in 1994. The firm's 2021 investment announcement says Mark Bremer joined shortly afterward and helped develop its analytical focus. Blue Point Capital Partners first invested in October 2021; Stax reported 200+ employees in its November 2021 announcement.

In October 2022, Stax promoted COO Jayson Traxler to President while Musher became Chairman. In November 2022, Stax acquired London-based AMR International, expanding its UK and European presence. Grant Thornton Advisors announced its acquisition of Stax in August 2025 and completed the transaction in September 2025.
